name: Captured
source:
A Girl X Boy visual novel where a mermaid named Amanti is at that age where she should learn magic. However, her adoptive mother, Unette, refuses to teach her. Amanti decides to find a place to think but winds up captured and imprisoned by humans who want to study her.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20201101103238/http://darksirengames.com/]Official Website[/url]]
